author: "Shuai Guo"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document

Robustness and comparability checks supporting Figure 1 (scripts 01 to 04).
Section 1 is the source of Supplementary Table S2 and section 3 the source of
Supplementary Table S3, whose primary TMB and SBS4 rows are taken from section 1;
both tables are written by 06_supplementary_tables.Rmd.

* **R2-1** the effect of hypermutated tumours, which are flagged but retained
* **R2-2** the effect of the reported-ancestry restriction
* **R2-4** variant class comparability, and the non-coding comparison that is
  deliberately kept out of the main text
* **R1-1, R2-6** leave-one-cohort-out robustness, and the copy number
  comparability audit

```{r setup}
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  source("_functions.R")

  dir.create("../results/05_sensitivity/tables", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create("../results/05_sensitivity/figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  n_boot = 2000
  set.seed(20260809)

  meta_all = load_metadata(drop_ancestry = FALSE, drop_hyper = FALSE)
  meta = load_metadata(drop_ancestry = TRUE, drop_hyper = FALSE)
  sig_wide = load_signature_relative()
  sig_list = active_signatures(sig_wide)
  point_class = load_point_mutation_classes()
  classes = c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")
  key_features = c("TMB", "SBS4", "SBS1", "SBS13", "C>A")
```

# 1. Hypermutation

## 1.1 Is the flag balanced across the four cells?

A fixed burden cut-off is not a neutral instrument here. Burden is far higher in
the Western cohorts, so a threshold removes mostly Western ever-smokers, that is
exactly the tumours carrying the effect under test.

```{r hyper-balance}
  defs = c("HypermutatedMechanism", "HypermutatedTMB10",
           "HypermutatedTMB20", "HypermutatedCohortExtreme")
  labels = c("mechanism (POLE/MMR/APOBEC)", "TMB >= 10", "TMB >= 20",
             "cohort Q3 + 3 IQR")
  bal = NULL
  for (i in seq_along(defs)) {
    flag = meta[[defs[i]]] %in% TRUE
    for (j in seq_along(CELL_LEVELS)) {
      rows = meta$Cell == CELL_LEVELS[j]
      bal = rbind(bal, data.frame(definition = labels[i], cell = CELL_LEVELS[j],
        n_cell = sum(rows), n_flagged = sum(flag & rows),
        pct_flagged = round(100 * sum(flag & rows) / sum(rows), 1),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  write.csv(bal, "../results/05_sensitivity/tables/01_hypermutation_balance.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  bal$cell = factor(bal$cell, levels = CELL_LEVELS)
  bal$definition = factor(bal$definition, levels = labels)
  p_bal = ggplot(bal, aes(x = cell, y = pct_flagged, fill = cell))
  p_bal = p_bal + geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE)
  p_bal = p_bal + geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_flagged, "%")), vjust = -0.35,
                            size = 2.4)
  p_bal = p_bal + facet_wrap(~ definition, nrow = 1)
  p_bal = p_bal + scale_fill_manual(values = CELL_COLS)
  p_bal = p_bal + scale_x_discrete(labels = c("EAS\nnever", "EAS\never",
                                              "West\nnever", "West\never"))
  p_bal = p_bal + labs(x = NULL, y = "tumours flagged (%)",
                       title = "A fixed burden cut-off removes Western ever-smokers preferentially")
  p_bal = p_bal + theme_pub()
  ggsave("../results/05_sensitivity/figures/hypermutation_balance.pdf", p_bal,
         width = 8.5, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)
  p_bal
```

```{r hyper-mechanism}
  mech = table(meta$HypermutationMechanism, meta$Cell)
```

## 1.2 Do the conclusions hold with hypermutated tumours removed?

```{r hyper-sensitivity}
  run_key = function(m, tag) {
    sm = merge(m, sig_wide, by = "SampleID")
    pm = merge(m, point_class, by = "SampleID")
    out = NULL
    d = m[m$HasTMB, ]
    r = did_medians(d$NonsynonymousPerMb, d$CohortGroup, d$Smoking, "TMB", n_boot)
    if (!is.null(r)) {
      out = rbind(out, r)
    }
    for (i in seq_along(key_features)) {
      f = key_features[i]
      if (f %in% names(sm)) {
        r = did_medians(sm[[f]], sm$CohortGroup, sm$Smoking, f, n_boot)
        if (!is.null(r)) {
          out = rbind(out, r)
        }
      }
      if (f %in% names(pm)) {
        r = did_medians(pm[[f]], pm$CohortGroup, pm$Smoking, f, n_boot)
        if (!is.null(r)) {
          out = rbind(out, r)
        }
      }
    }
    out$scenario = tag
    out$n_total = nrow(m)
    out
  }

  sens = NULL
  sens = rbind(sens, run_key(meta, "full"))
  sens = rbind(sens, run_key(meta[!(meta$HypermutatedMechanism %in% TRUE), ],
                             "exclude mechanism"))
  sens = rbind(sens, run_key(meta[!meta$HypermutatedTMB10, ], "exclude TMB >= 10"))
  sens = rbind(sens, run_key(meta[!meta$HypermutatedTMB20, ], "exclude TMB >= 20"))
  sens = rbind(sens, run_key(meta[!meta$HypermutatedCohortExtreme, ],
                             "exclude cohort extreme"))
  write.csv(sens, "../results/05_sensitivity/tables/03_hypermutation_sensitivity.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)

  sens$scenario = factor(sens$scenario, levels = c("full", "exclude mechanism",
    "exclude TMB >= 10", "exclude TMB >= 20", "exclude cohort extreme"))
  p_sens = forest_plot(sens, "did", "ci_low", "ci_high", "scenario", "feature",
                       c("TMB" = "#2C3E50", "SBS4" = "#C0392B", "SBS1" = "#3B6FB6",
                         "SBS13" = "#7F8C8D", "C>A" = "#E67E22"),
                       "difference in differences (95% CI)",
                       "The interaction holds under every hypermutation definition")
  p_sens = p_sens + facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1)
  p_sens = p_sens + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(sens$scenario)))
  ggsave("../results/05_sensitivity/figures/hypermutation_sensitivity.pdf", p_sens,
         width = 10, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)
  sens[sens$feature %in% c("TMB", "SBS4"),
       c("feature", "scenario", "n_total", "did", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_bootstrap")]
```

# 2. Leave one cohort out

```{r loco}
  loco = NULL
  drops = c("none", unique(meta$Cohort))
  for (k in seq_along(drops)) {
    m = meta
    if (drops[k] != "none") {
      m = meta[meta$Cohort != drops[k], ]
    }
    if (length(unique(m$CohortGroup)) < 2) {
      next
    }
    r = run_key(m, drops[k])
    if (!is.null(r)) {
      r$dropped = drops[k]
      loco = rbind(loco, r)
    }
  }
  write.csv(loco, "../results/05_sensitivity/tables/04_leave_one_cohort_out.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  show = loco[loco$feature %in% c("TMB", "SBS4", "SBS1"), ]
  show$dropped = factor(show$dropped, levels = drops)
  p_loco = forest_plot(show, "did", "ci_low", "ci_high", "dropped", "feature",
                       c("TMB" = "#2C3E50", "SBS4" = "#C0392B", "SBS1" = "#3B6FB6"),
                       "difference in differences (95% CI)",
                       "Leave one cohort out")
  p_loco = p_loco + facet_wrap(~ feature, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1)
  p_loco = p_loco + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(drops))
  ggsave("../results/05_sensitivity/figures/leave_one_cohort_out.pdf", p_loco,
         width = 8, height = 3.2, device = cairo_pdf)
  show[show$feature == "SBS4", c("dropped", "n_total", "did", "ci_low",
                                 "ci_high", "p_bootstrap")]
```

# 3. Reported-ancestry restriction

```{r ancestry-sensitivity}
  race = tolower(as.character(meta_all$ReportedRace))
  white_only = meta_all
  is_west = white_only$CohortGroup == "Western"
  keep_west = is_west & grepl("white", race)
  white_only = white_only[!is_west | keep_west, ]

  anc = NULL
  anc = rbind(anc, run_key(meta_all, "all patients"))
  anc = rbind(anc, run_key(meta, "exclude self-reported Asian"))
  anc = rbind(anc, run_key(white_only, "Western restricted to reported White"))
  write.csv(anc, "../results/05_sensitivity/tables/05_ancestry_restriction.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  counts = data.frame(scenario = c("all patients", "exclude self-reported Asian",
                                   "Western restricted to reported White"),
                      n = c(nrow(meta_all), nrow(meta), nrow(white_only)),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  counts
  anc[anc$feature %in% c("TMB", "SBS4"),
      c("feature", "scenario", "n_total", "did", "ci_low", "ci_high", "p_bootstrap")]
```

# 4. Variant class comparability

```{r variant-class}
  vc = read.csv("../data/variant_class_audit.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.csv(vc, "../results/05_sensitivity/tables/06_variant_class_audit.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  vc

  long = rbind(
    data.frame(Cohort = vc$Cohort, class = "protein-altering", n = vc$ProteinAltering),
    data.frame(Cohort = vc$Cohort, class = "silent", n = vc$Silent),
    data.frame(Cohort = vc$Cohort, class = "non-coding", n = vc$Noncoding))
  long$Cohort = factor(long$Cohort,
                       levels = vc$Cohort[order(vc$NoncodingToProteinRatio)])
  p_vc = ggplot(long, aes(x = Cohort, y = n, fill = class))
  p_vc = p_vc + geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.7)
  p_vc = p_vc + scale_fill_manual(values = c("protein-altering" = "#C0392B",
                                             "silent" = "#7F8C8D",
                                             "non-coding" = "#3B6FB6"), name = NULL)
  p_vc = p_vc + labs(x = NULL, y = "share of called variants",
                     title = "Variant class composition tracks annotation depth, not biology")
  p_vc = p_vc + theme_pub()
  p_vc = p_vc + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
                      legend.position = "top")
  ggsave("../results/05_sensitivity/figures/variant_class.pdf", p_vc,
         width = 5, height = 3.6, device = cairo_pdf)
  p_vc
```

```{r noncoding}
  nc = NULL
  for (co in PER_COHORT_SET) {
    d = fread(paste0("../data/", co, "_snv.csv"), data.table = FALSE,
              showProgress = FALSE)
    d = d[d$SampleID %in% meta$SampleID, ]
    tot = table(d$SampleID)
    ncc = table(d$SampleID[d$VariantClass == "noncoding"])
    ids = names(tot)
    v = as.integer(ncc[ids])
    v[is.na(v)] = 0
    nc = rbind(nc, data.frame(SampleID = ids, n_total = as.integer(tot[ids]),
                              n_noncoding = v, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  nc = merge(meta[, c("SampleID", "Cohort", "CohortGroup", "Smoking")], nc,
             by = "SampleID")
  nc_summary = aggregate(cbind(n_total, n_noncoding) ~ Cohort + CohortGroup + Smoking,
                         data = nc, FUN = median)
  write.csv(nc_summary, "../results/05_sensitivity/tables/07_noncoding_by_cohort.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  nc_summary
```

A cross-cohort comparison of non-coding variant frequency measures annotation
and capture practice rather than biology, which is why it stays in this
repository and is not cited in the main text.

# 5. Copy number comparability

```{r cnv-audit}
  audit = data.frame(
    cohort = c("Chen2020", "TCGA2014", "TRACERx2023", "Guo2026", "Xu2020", "Chen2019"),
    level = c("sample", "sample", "sample", "sample", "aggregate", "aggregate"),
    quantification = c("GISTIC discrete -2..2",
                       "ASCAT2 absolute integer copy number",
                       "GISTIC peak calls, AMP/DEL, clonal/subclonal",
                       "segment-level gain/loss with LOH, encoding undocumented",
                       "published gene by tumour counts",
                       "published arm-level frequencies, two rows"),
    genome_build = c("hg19", "hg38", "hg19", "hg38", "unknown", "unknown"),
    used_here = c(TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  write.csv(audit, "../results/05_sensitivity/tables/08_cnv_comparability_audit.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
  audit
```

Copy number is not compared in this release. The three sample-level
quantifications flagged `used_here` by the earlier pipeline (GISTIC discrete
calls, ASCAT2 absolute copy number, GISTIC peak calls) share no common scale, so
any threshold would compare pipelines rather than tumours.

# 6. Power of the pairwise separation test

```{r wilcox-floor}
  floor_p = wilcox.test(c(4, 5, 6, 7), c(1, 2))$p.value
  cat("smallest attainable P with 4 cross-ancestry and 2 within-ancestry pairs:",
      round(floor_p, 4), "\n")
  cat("the informative statistic is complete separation, not this P value\n")
```
